title: gypsophila muralis subsp. repens
intro: Gypsophila muralis subsp. repens, commonly known as creeping gypsophila, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This perennial herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of sleep quality, and relief from anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of creeping gypsophila include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for insomnia and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
